item.title: Cinemark CEO Is Glad Paramount Won Warner Bros.
item.description: Sean Gamble told an investors conference a longtime supporter of theatrical exhibition had prevailed in the merger battle.

item.title: David Zaslav Sells $114 Million in Warner Bros. Discovery Stock
item.description: Other top WBD execs, including Bruce Campbell, JB Perrette and Gunnar Weidenfels also sold shares as a window opened following nearly a year of dealmaking.

item.title: Why ‘The Bride!’ Director Maggie Gyllenhaal Says Warner Bros. Asked Her to Cut Some Violence From Film: “It’s Just Too Much”
item.description: The film, starring Jessie Buckley and Christian Bale, hits theaters March 6.

item.title: Maria O’Brien, ‘Protocol’ and ‘Matlock’ Actress, Dies at 75
item.description: O'Brien also worked as an acting coach on 'Days of Our Lives' for 15 years.

item.title: Christian Bale Weighs in on “Bold Choice” to Make a New ‘American Psycho’: “All the Best to ‘Em”
item.description: The original Patrick Bateman gave his thoughts on Luca Guadagnino's new adaptation while premiering his latest film 'The Bride!' on Tuesday.
